notes: New: more charts for a flight. Above the height chart, pick Speed, Climb (up and down), Battery % or GPS satellites. The replay line moves along whichever chart you picked, and the map remembers your choice
New: the Stats tab. Your flying in numbers (flights, air time, distance, days flown, photos and video), for all time or one year
New: a calendar of the days you flew, one square per day (darker = more air time). Click a day to see its flights

New: battery health. Each battery gets a card: how much it holds compared with a new one, a line of its capacity flight by flight, how much it uses per minute, its temperatures and the voltage difference between its cells (when your logs have them). A rough guide only: DJI Fly's battery page is the official reading
New: your records (longest, highest, furthest from take-off), and each drone's totals. Click a record to open that flight
Stats for each drone: choose a drone next to "Show" in the Stats tab, or press the new Stats button on a drone's card in the Aircraft tab. Each battery card says which drone(s) it flew in

Fixed: a flight log that said its video was longer than the whole flight (seen: 6½ hours of video in a 7-minute flight) made the video time wrong. Such a number is no longer trusted: the flight shows "–" for its video
Your flights are read once more after this update (to collect the new battery numbers), so the first start can take a little longer
